description.value: Ratio Coffee & Pastry is a community-rooted Vernon café with an origin story tailor-made for cyclists: it began as a coffee cart on bike wheels before growing into a full-service espresso and pastry destination. The café is known for its quality-first ethos, daily brunch service, and a cult-favourite Friday donut program that sells out on a pre-order system. A private meeting room and a warm, inviting atmosphere round out a spot that has clearly become a social hub for the neighbourhood.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded successfully and confirms an active business with full ordering capabilities, a meeting room booking page, and contact details including address (3101 29 Street #4, Vernon, BC V1T 5A8) and phone ((250) 545-9800) found on the /s/appointments subpage. Takeout is confirmed by the 'ORDER BRUNCH TO GO' CTA and online pre-order system. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging appears anywhere on the site. The OSM name uses 'and' while the website consistently uses '&', which is flagged as a discrepancy.
concerns: OSM name 'Ratio Coffee and Pastry' uses 'and' while the website consistently brands as 'Ratio Coffee & Pastry' (ampersand). OSM name retained per rules.
Address and phone absent from OSM tags; both values sourced from website (/s/appointments subpage).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café in Vernon with a fully functional website, online ordering, and confirmed physical address. A natural refuelling stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: began as a coffee cart on bike wheels before growing into a full-service espresso and pastry destination
